title: Null-pointer crash on empty cart checkout
description: Checkout crashed when the cart was empty and a coupon applied. The coupon path dereferenced the first cart item without checking. Three steps reproduce it every time.
symptom: Crash: null pointer in coupon application
minimal_repro_steps: Add nothing to cart|Apply coupon SAVE10|Press checkout
root_cause: Coupon path dereferenced cart.items[0] without an empty check
fix: Guard clause returns early on empty carts; added regression test.

title: Hang on concurrent report export
